hero.headline: A system built to put *7 paid assessments* on Advantage Therapy's calendar in your first 6 weeks
hero.subhead: Phil, this is the exact engine we'd run for you: the ads, the page they land on, an AI agent that answers every lead in seconds, and the follow-up that catches everyone who slips through. Scroll through it, then try the agent yourself.

engine_intro: Your site says you text and don't take calls, which makes sense when you're hands-on with a patient for 60 minutes. The engine is built for exactly that: new ad leads, past patients and every missed call land with one AI agent that replies in seconds and books the free phone consult. Anyone who doesn't book, no-shows or finishes care gets recycled back into reactivation instead of forgotten.
step_blurbs: Ads put you in front of Las Vegas adults who've already tried massage, adjustments and PT, and are done living with it.

The agent texts and chats with every lead in seconds, answers the insurance and price questions, and books the consult.

close_intro: We're running this as a pilot with a handful of practices to build case studies before rates go up. Here's what we commit to.
chat_context:
Advantage Therapy - Manual Physical Therapy, Las Vegas NV. Specializes in manual physical therapy for chronic pain (pain lasting months or years).

Clinicians: Dr. Phil Young DPT, CIDN (B.S. Human Movement, Utah State; Doctorate of Physical Therapy, Rocky Mountain University; spent over a decade with chronic back pain himself before finding what worked) and Dr. Monique Lawson DPT, CIDN. Both certified in dry needling and manual manipulation.

Approach: one-on-one, hands-on, 60 full minutes per session. 1) detailed assessment to find the movement, joint, muscle or nerve dysfunction causing the pain, 2) targeted manual therapy based on those findings, 3) prescribed home exercises, 4) reassess and progress as the patient improves. Goal is quick, long-lasting results and a very high success rate of avoiding surgery.

Conditions: chronic back pain, neck pain, shoulder pain, TMJ dysfunction, hip pain, plantar fasciitis and other foot pain, radiating pain or numbness into arms/hands/legs/feet, sciatica, bursitis, tendonitis. Athletes and everyday people. Great fit for people who tried PT, chiropractic adjustments, massage or acupuncture without lasting results.

Services: dry needling (with e-stim), neuro/myofascial release, dynamic cupping, joint mobilization, joint manipulation, radial shockwave, focused shockwave, neuromuscular re-education, lumbar traction, cervical traction, kinesiology tape, instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilization (scraping).

First step: a FREE phone consult (by text or call) to cover pricing, availability and whether it's a good fit. This is what you book.

Pricing (cash-pay): initial evaluation $250 (60 minutes, includes hands-on treatment and a home exercise plan). Follow-up sessions $250, or $800 for a package of 4. Optional home exercise equipment kit $50.
Insurance: does NOT accept insurance, on purpose (insurance care often means rushed sessions and 10-20+ visits). HSA/FSA cards accepted. Superbills provided for out-of-network reimbursement. Many patients say it costs less in the long run because they get results in a few sessions.

Location: inside SVG3 Fitness, 6416 Arville St, Las Vegas NV 89118. Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm. Contact: text (702) 803-3042 (they text, they don't answer calls), info@advantagetherapy.vegas.

Real Google review (Greg B.): 10 years of low back pain, months of PT without results; pain went from 8/10 to nearly none in the first session and to a lasting 0/10 after 4 more treatments.
